CITY OF SAN MARINO

  DESIGN REVIEW COMMITTEE AGENDA

Raymond Cheng, Chair

Suzanne Torgeson, Vice Chair  www.sanmarinoca.gov

Rick Chou, Member  (626) 300­0700 Phone

Ted Lee, Member  San Marino City Hall

Steven Jones, Member  2200 Huntington Drive

  San Marino, CA 91108

  REGULAR MEETING OF THE
  DESIGN REVIEW COMMITTEE
  WEDNESDAY, AUGUST 20, 2025 AT 6:00 PM
  BARTH ROOM CROWELL PUBLIC LIBRARY
  1890 HUNTINGTON DRIVE
  SAN MARINO, CA 91108

The City of San Marino appreciates your attendance. Citizens’ interest provides the Design Review
Committee with valuable information regarding issues of the community.

Regular meetings are held on the 1st and 3rd Wednesday of every month at 6:00 p.m.

In compliance with the American Disabilities Act, any person with a disability who requires
modification or accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the City at (626)
300­0700 or at Planning@SanMarinoCA.gov at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.

The public is welcome to attend the meeting in person or remotely via Zoom, however, the meeting
will proceed as normal even if there are technical difficulties with Zoom. The City will do it’s
best to resolve any technical issues as quickly as possible.

How to participate in the meeting from home:
Visit www.SanMarinoCA.gov/Zoom

How to offer public comment from home:
How to offer public comment from home: Public comment will be accepted by email to
Planning@SanMarinoCA.gov until 3:00 p.m. the day of the meeting. Written public comment
received by 3:00 p.m. will be distributed to the Design Review Committee during the meeting. Any
comments received after 3:00 p.m. will be included in the public comment record but not provided
to the Design Review Committee at the meeting. Written public comment will be accepted
electronically via the zoom.us teleconference module during the meeting. Written

AGENDA – AUGUST 20, 2025  PAGE 1 of 3
 Zoom comments will be accepted after the in­person comments.

FOR FURTHER INFORMATION please contact the Planning Division at (626) 300­0700. A
copy of the staff reports under review at this Design Review Committee meeting will be
available for public review by the end of the day, August 14, 2025, on the City’s website at:
www.SanMarinoCA.gov.

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL

Alternate Nora Hoyos, Member Steven Jones, Member Ted Lee, Member Rick Chou, Vice Chair
Suzanne Torgeson, Chair Raymond Cheng

POSTING OF AGENDA

The agenda is posted 72 hours prior to each meeting at the following locations: City Hall,
2200 Huntington Drive, the Crowell Public Library, 1890 Huntington Drive, and the
Stoneman Building, 1560 Pasqualito Drive. The agenda is also posted on the City’s website:
http://www.SanMarinoCA.gov.

PUBLIC COMMENTS

The City welcomes public input. Members of the public may address the Design Review
Committee by completing a public comment card and giving it to the Community
Development Director prior to the meeting. At this time, the public may address the Design Review
Committee on items that are not on the agenda. Pursuant to state law, the Design Review
Committee may not discuss or take action on issues not on the meeting agenda (Government
Code Section 54954.3). The Chair reserves the right to place limits on duration of comments.
Staff may be asked to follow up on such items.

AGENDA – AUGUST 20, 2025  PAGE 2 of 3
   PUBLIC HEARINGS

1.  CONSIDERATION OF APPROVAL FOR DESIGN REVIEW CASE NOS. DR
  25-29 AND DR 25-38 AT 2829 CARLARIS ROAD FOR REPLACEMENT OF
  STREET-FACING SIDE YARD FENCING AND GATES & THE
  INSTALLATION OF CERTAINTEED PRESIDENTIAL SHAKE TL IN THE
  SHADOW GRAY COLOR (HOWARD)
  Recommendation: Based on the information submitted to the record, staff recommends
  the Design Review Committee: (1) Determine that the proposed project is exempt from
  CEQA pursuant to State CEQA Guidelines, Section 15301, Class 1 (Existing Facilities), and
  that there is no substantial evidence demonstrating an exception to the categorical
  exemption pursuant to CEQA Guidelines Section 15300.2 applies; (2) Find that the project
  meets all applicable findings; and (3) Approve the project with the added condition that
  the special installation requirements for composition fiberglass single roofing material
  listed on the City’s Pre-Approved Roofing Materials, Colors, and Applications List shall be
  applied.

  Planner: Arielle Truong, Assistant Planner

  CONSENT CALENDAR

2.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES
  Recommendation: Staff recommends the Design Review Committee approve the special
  meeting minutes of July 16, 2025.

DIRECTOR'S REPORT

This is an opportunity for the Community Development Director to inform the Design Review
Committee and the public of any matters of interest.

WRITTEN COMMUNICATIONS OR PUBLIC WRITINGS DISTRIBUTION

This is an opportunity to announce any written communications pertaining to the City received
by members of the Design Review Committee. All public writings distributed by the City of San
Marino to at least a majority of the Design Review Committee regarding any item on this agenda
will be made available at the Public Counter at City Hall located at 2200 Huntington Drive, San
Marino, California 91108, and will also be included in the public agenda packet that will available
for review at the Design Review Committee meeting.

ADJOURNMENT

Posted: August 14, 2025  ISIDRO FIGUEROA
  COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT DIRECTOR
